load_rdata_sf <- function(dataset_name, base_url, dest_dir) {
  file_url <- paste0(base_url, dataset_name, ".RData")
  dest_file <- file.path(dest_dir, paste0(dataset_name, ".RData"))
  resp <- tryCatch(httr::GET(file_url, httr::write_disk(dest_file, overwrite = TRUE)),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
  code <- if(is.null(resp)) NA_integer_ else httr::status_code(resp)
  if(is.na(code) || code >= 400 || !file.exists(dest_file)) {
    stop(paste0("Download failed for '", dataset_name, ".RData'. HTTP code: ", code))
  }
  temp_env <- new.env()
  loaded <- tryCatch(load(dest_file, envir = temp_env), error = function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(loaded) || length(loaded) == 0) {
    stop(paste0("Could not load any object from '", dataset_name, ".RData'."))
  }
  obj <- temp_env[[loaded[1]]]
  if(!inherits(obj, "sf")) {
    stop(paste0("Object in '", dataset_name, ".RData' is not an sf object."))
  }
  obj
}

  "Bogota_Limite_Survey",
  "Rio_Frio_Sitios_Neguanje",

  "Filandia_Sitios_Periodo_Temprano",
  "Filandia_Sitios_Periodo_Medio",
  "Filandia_Sitios_Periodo_Tardio",
  "Bogota_Sitios_Early_Herrera",

  "Bogota_Sitios_Muisca"
)

sf_objects <- lapply(dataset_names, function(name) {
  load_rdata_sf(name, github_base_url, temp_dir)
})
names(sf_objects) <- dataset_names

clean_boundary <- function(sf_obj, target_epsg) {
  x <- sf_obj
  x <- st_zm(x, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")
  x <- st_make_valid(x)
  x <- x[!st_is_empty(x), ]
  x <- st_transform(x, target_epsg)
  st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_geometry(x)))
}

load_sites <- function(sf_obj, target_epsg, region_tag, period_tag) {
  x <- sf_obj
  x <- st_zm(x, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")
  x <- st_make_valid(x)
  x <- x[!st_is_empty(x), ]
  x <- suppressWarnings(st_collection_extract(x, "POLYGON"))
  x <- suppressWarnings(st_cast(x, "MULTIPOLYGON"))
  x <- x[!st_is_empty(x), ]
  x <- st_make_valid(x)
  x <- st_transform(x, target_epsg)
  if("Size_HA" %in% names(x)) {
    x$Site_Area_HA <- as.numeric(x$Size_HA)
  } else {
    x$Site_Area_HA <- as.numeric(st_area(x)) / 10000
  }
  if("Site_ID" %in% names(x)) {
    x$Site_ID <- as.character(x$Site_ID)
  } else {
    x$Site_ID <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(x)))
  }
  x$Region <- region_tag
  x$Period <- period_tag
  x[, c("Site_ID", "Region", "Period", "Site_Area_HA")]
}

Section 4: Spatial Conversion

sf_to_ppp <- function(points_sf, bound_sf) {
  win <- as.owin(st_make_valid(st_union(st_geometry(bound_sf))))
  pts <- suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(st_make_valid(points_sf)))
  cc <- st_coordinates(pts)
  pp <- ppp(x = cc[,1], y = cc[,2], window = win)
  pp[win]
}

build_ppp_list <- function(site_list, bound) {
  lapply(site_list, function(x) sf_to_ppp(x, bound))
}

ppp_tairona  <- build_ppp_list(sites_tairona, bound_tairona)
ppp_quimbaya <- build_ppp_list(sites_quimbaya, bound_quimbaya)
ppp_muisca   <- build_ppp_list(sites_muisca, bound_muisca)

Section 5: Settlement Pattern Metrics and Survey Comparability

calc_baseline_metrics <- function(pp_list, region) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(pp_list), function(p) {
    pp <- pp_list[[p]]
    area_km2 <- area.owin(pp$window) / 1e6
    nn_dists <- nndist(pp)
    ce_test <- clarkevans.test(pp, correction = "cdf", alternative = "two.sided")
    tibble(
      Region = region,
      Period = p,
      Survey_Area_km2 = round(area_km2, 2),
      N_Sites = pp$n,
      Settlement_Density = round(pp$n / area_km2, 2),
      Mean_Spacing_m = round(mean(nn_dists), 1),
      SD_Spacing_m = round(sd(nn_dists), 1),
      Min_Spacing_m = round(min(nn_dists), 1),
      Max_Spacing_m = round(max(nn_dists), 1),
      Clark_Evans_R = round(as.numeric(ce_test$statistic), 3),
      CE_p_value = signif(as.numeric(ce_test$p.value), 3),
      Pattern_Type = case_when(
        as.numeric(ce_test$statistic) < 0.9 ~ "Aggregated",
        as.numeric(ce_test$statistic) > 1.1 ~ "Regular",
        TRUE ~ "Random"
      )
    )
  }))
}

table1 <- bind_rows(
  calc_baseline_metrics(ppp_tairona, "Tairona"),
  calc_baseline_metrics(ppp_quimbaya, "Quimbaya"),
  calc_baseline_metrics(ppp_muisca, "Muisca")
)

bbox_extent <- function(bound_sf, region) {
  bb <- st_bbox(bound_sf)
  tibble(
    Region = region,
    Extent_X_km = round(as.numeric(bb["xmax"] - bb["xmin"]) / 1000, 2),
    Extent_Y_km = round(as.numeric(bb["ymax"] - bb["ymin"]) / 1000, 2),
    Boundary_Area_km2 = round(as.numeric(st_area(bound_sf)) / 1e6, 2)
  )
}

survey_comparability <- bind_rows(
  bbox_extent(bound_tairona, "Tairona"),
  bbox_extent(bound_quimbaya, "Quimbaya"),
  bbox_extent(bound_muisca, "Muisca")
) %>%
  left_join(
    table1 %>% group_by(Region) %>%
      summarise(
        Mean_Density = round(mean(Settlement_Density), 2),
        Min_Density = round(min(Settlement_Density), 2),
        Max_Density = round(max(Settlement_Density), 2),
        N_Periods = n(),
        Total_Sites_All_Periods = sum(N_Sites),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "Region"
  )

survey_comparability_print <- survey_comparability %>%

Section 6: Inter-Site Spacing (Bullet Plot)

bullet_levels <- c("Neguanje", "Buritaca", "Tairona",
                   "Early", "Middle", "Late",
                   "Early Herrera", "Late Herrera", "Muisca")

param_mean_ci <- function(values) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  n <- length(values)
  m <- mean(values)
  if(n < 2) {
    return(tibble(Mean = m, L80 = m, U80 = m, L95 = m, U95 = m, L99 = m, U99 = m, N = n))
  }
  ser <- sd(values) / sqrt(n)
  t80 <- qt(0.90, n - 1)
  t95 <- qt(0.975, n - 1)
  t99 <- qt(0.995, n - 1)
  tibble(
    Mean = m,
    L80 = m - (ser * t80), U80 = m + (ser * t80),
    L95 = m - (ser * t95), U95 = m + (ser * t95),
    L99 = m - (ser * t99), U99 = m + (ser * t99),
    N = n
  )
}

boot_mean_ci <- function(values, n_boot = 10000, conf = c(0.80, 0.95, 0.99)) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  n <- length(values)
  if(n < 2) {
    m <- if(n == 1) values[1] else NA_real_
    return(tibble(Mean = m, L80 = m, U80 = m, L95 = m, U95 = m, L99 = m, U99 = m, N = n))
  }
  boot_means <- future.apply::future_vapply(
    seq_len(n_boot),
    function(b) mean(sample(values, n, replace = TRUE)),
    FUN.VALUE = numeric(1),
    future.seed = TRUE
  )
  qs <- quantile(boot_means, c((1 - conf) / 2, 1 - (1 - conf) / 2))
  tibble(
    Mean = mean(values),
    L80 = as.numeric(qs[3]), U80 = as.numeric(qs[6]),
    L95 = as.numeric(qs[2]), U95 = as.numeric(qs[5]),
    L99 = as.numeric(qs[1]), U99 = as.numeric(qs[4]),
    N = n
  )
}

nnd_by_period <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(lapply(names(ppp_tairona), function(p) {
    tibble(Region = "Tairona", Period = p, NND = nndist(ppp_tairona[[p]]))
  })),
  bind_rows(lapply(names(ppp_quimbaya), function(p) {
    tibble(Region = "Quimbaya", Period = p, NND = nndist(ppp_quimbaya[[p]]))
  })),
  bind_rows(lapply(names(ppp_muisca), function(p) {
    tibble(Region = "Muisca", Period = p, NND = nndist(ppp_muisca[[p]]))
  }))
)

bullet_spacing <- nnd_by_period %>%
  group_by(Region, Period) %>%
  group_modify(~ param_mean_ci(.x$NND)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Tairona", "Quimbaya", "Muisca")),
         Period = factor(Period, levels = bullet_levels))

p_bullet_spacing <- ggplot(bullet_spacing, aes(x = Period, color = Region)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = L99, ymax = U99), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = L95, ymax = U95), linewidth = 3) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = L80, ymax = U80), linewidth = 6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean, ymax = Mean), width = 0.3, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Region, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_palette) +
  labs(title = "Figure 2: Inter-Site Spacing Across Periods (Bullet Plot)",
       subtitle = "Parametric means of nearest-neighbor distance with 80/95/99% confidence intervals",
       x = NULL, y = "Nearest-neighbor distance (m)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray40"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
        legend.position = "none")

print(p_bullet_spacing)

  transmute(Region, Period, N,
            Mean_NND_m = round(Mean, 1),

Section 7: Settlement Nucleation Intensity

surfer_pal <- c(
  rgb(200, 215, 133, maxColorValue = 255),
  rgb(117, 193, 120, maxColorValue = 255),
  rgb(241, 207, 14, maxColorValue = 255),
  rgb(242, 167, 0, maxColorValue = 255),
  rgb(252, 236, 192, maxColorValue = 255),
  rgb(115, 224, 241, maxColorValue = 255),
  rgb(29, 188, 239, maxColorValue = 255),
  rgb(0, 80, 250, maxColorValue = 255)
)

calc_weighted_intensity <- function(poly_sf, label, bound_sf) {
  pts <- suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(poly_sf))
  coords <- st_coordinates(pts)
  areas <- poly_sf$Site_Area_HA
  areas[!is.finite(areas) | areas <= 0] <- NA_real_
  if(all(is.na(areas))) {
    areas <- rep(1, length(areas))
  } else {
    areas[is.na(areas)] <- min(areas, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  win <- as.owin(bound_sf)
  pp_weighted <- ppp(x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2], window = win, marks = areas)
  pp_weighted <- pp_weighted[win]
  win_diag <- sqrt(diff(win$xrange)^2 + diff(win$yrange)^2)
  fallback_bw <- as.numeric(mean(nndist(pp_weighted))) * 1.5
  if(!is.finite(fallback_bw) || fallback_bw <= 0) fallback_bw <- win_diag / 50
  optimal_bw <- tryCatch({
    b <- suppressWarnings(bw.ppl(pp_weighted))
    if(!is.finite(as.numeric(b)) || as.numeric(b) <= 0) stop("non-finite bw")
    as.numeric(b)
  }, error = function(e) {
    b2 <- tryCatch(as.numeric(bw.diggle(pp_weighted)), error = function(e2) NA_real_)
    if(!is.finite(b2) || b2 <= 0) fallback_bw else b2
  })
  dens <- density(pp_weighted, sigma = optimal_bw, weights = marks(pp_weighted),
                  edge = TRUE, diggle = TRUE, dimyx = 512)
  df_rast <- as.data.frame(dens, xy = TRUE)
  df_rast$value_scaled <- df_rast$value * 1e6
  df_rast$Period <- label
  list(raster = df_rast, bw = as.numeric(optimal_bw))
}

prepare_plot_data_weighted <- function(sites_sf_list, region_name, bound_sf, lvls) {
  out_list <- lapply(names(sites_sf_list), function(p) {
    calc_weighted_intensity(sites_sf_list[[p]], p, bound_sf)
  })
  raster_list <- lapply(out_list, function(o) o$raster)
  bw_vec <- sapply(out_list, function(o) o$bw)
  names(bw_vec) <- names(sites_sf_list)
  df_raster <- bind_rows(raster_list)
  poly_list <- lapply(names(sites_sf_list), function(p) {
    s <- sites_sf_list[[p]]
    s$Period <- p
    s[, "Period"]
  })
  df_poly <- bind_rows(poly_list)
  df_raster$Period <- factor(df_raster$Period, levels = lvls)
  df_poly$Period <- factor(df_poly$Period, levels = lvls)
  list(raster = df_raster, polygons = df_poly, bw = bw_vec)
}

create_panel <- function(data, bounds, title_text) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = data$raster, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value_scaled), interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_sf(data = bounds, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_sf(data = data$polygons, fill = "black", color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~Period, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = surfer_pal, name = "Density\n(Ha / km2)") +
    coord_sf(crs = st_crs(bounds), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_bw() +
    annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.2, style = "bar", text_cex = 0.7) +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "tl", which_north = "true",
                           style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(text_size = 7),
                           height = unit(1, "cm"), width = unit(1, "cm")) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

gini_coef <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(x[is.finite(x) & x >= 0])
  n <- length(x)
  if(n == 0 || sum(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  G <- sum((2 * seq_len(n) - n - 1) * x) / (n * sum(x))
  G
}

summarise_intensity <- function(d, region, lvls) {
  d$raster %>%
    group_by(Period) %>%
    summarise(
      Region = region,
      Max_Intensity_Ha_km2 = round(max(value_scaled), 2),
      Mean_Intensity_Ha_km2 = round(mean(value_scaled), 2),
      Median_Intensity_Ha_km2 = round(median(value_scaled), 2),
      Gini_Intensity = round(gini_coef(value_scaled), 3),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = lvls)) %>%
    arrange(Period) %>%
    mutate(Optimal_Bandwidth_m = round(as.numeric(d$bw[as.character(Period)]), 1))
}

Section 9: Inter-Settlement Connectivity Networks

build_knn_network <- function(pp, k = 6) {
  coords <- cbind(pp$x, pp$y)
  n <- nrow(coords)
  D <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  adj_knn <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = n, ncol = n)
  for(i in 1:n) {
    k_eff <- min(k, n - 1)
    neighbors <- order(D[i, ])[2:(k_eff + 1)]
    adj_knn[i, neighbors] <- TRUE
  }
  adj_knn <- adj_knn | t(adj_knn)
  g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_knn, mode = "undirected")
  deg <- degree(g)
  btw <- betweenness(g, normalized = TRUE)
  base_metrics <- c(
    avg_degree = mean(deg),
    degree_cv = sd(deg) / mean(deg),
    transitivity = transitivity(g, type = "global"),
    degree_centralization = centr_degree(g)$centralization,
    assortativity = assortativity_degree(g, directed = FALSE),
    mean_betweenness = mean(btw),
    max_betweenness = max(btw),
    sd_betweenness = sd(btw)
  )
  list(coords = coords, adj = adj_knn, degree = deg, betweenness = btw,
       summary = tibble(Metric = names(base_metrics), Value = as.numeric(base_metrics)))
}

plot_knn_network <- function(pp, bound_sf, label, color_low, color_high, k = 6) {
  net_result <- build_knn_network(pp, k = k)
  coords <- net_result$coords
  adj <- net_result$adj
  deg <- net_result$degree
  net_centr <- net_result$summary$Value[net_result$summary$Metric == "degree_centralization"]
  net_maxbtw <- net_result$summary$Value[net_result$summary$Metric == "max_betweenness"]
  metric_caption <- paste0("Centralization = ", formatC(net_centr, format = "f", digits = 3),
                           " | Max betweenness = ", formatC(net_maxbtw, format = "f", digits = 3))
  edges <- which(adj & upper.tri(adj), arr.ind = TRUE)
  seg_df <- if(nrow(edges) > 0) {
    data.frame(x = coords[edges[,1], 1], y = coords[edges[,1], 2],
               xend = coords[edges[,2], 1], yend = coords[edges[,2], 2])
  } else {
    data.frame(x = numeric(), y = numeric(), xend = numeric(), yend = numeric())
  }
  z_degree <- scale(deg)[,1]
  nodes_df <- data.frame(x = coords[,1], y = coords[,2], z_score = z_degree)
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = bound_sf, fill = "gray97", color = "gray85") +
    geom_segment(data = seg_df, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                 color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = nodes_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = z_score, size = abs(z_score)),
               shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.6, alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = color_low, mid = "gray85", high = color_high,
                         midpoint = 0, name = "Connectivity\n(Z-score)",
                         guide = guide_colorbar(order = 1)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), name = "Magnitude\n(Abs Z)",
                          guide = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
    theme_void() +
    annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.25, style = "ticks") +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "tl", which_north = "true",
                           style = north_arrow_minimal(), height = unit(0.6, "cm")) +
    labs(subtitle = label, caption = metric_caption) +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 6.5, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm")
    )
  list(plot = p, summary = net_result$summary)
}

extract_full_net_summary <- function(net_list, ppp_list, region) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(net_list), function(p) {
    s <- net_list[[p]]$summary
    val <- function(m) s$Value[s$Metric == m]
    tibble(
      Region = region,
      Period = p,
      N_Sites = ppp_list[[p]]$n,
      Avg_Degree = round(val("avg_degree"), 3),
      Degree_CV = round(val("degree_cv"), 3),
      Transitivity = round(val("transitivity"), 3),
      Degree_Centralization = round(val("degree_centralization"), 4),
      Assortativity = round(val("assortativity"), 3),
      Mean_Betweenness = round(val("mean_betweenness"), 4),
      Max_Betweenness = round(val("max_betweenness"), 4),
      SD_Betweenness = round(val("sd_betweenness"), 4)
    )
  }))
}

  extract_full_net_summary(net_quimbaya, ppp_quimbaya, "Quimbaya"),
  extract_full_net_summary(net_muisca, ppp_muisca, "Muisca")

Section 10: Settlement Organization Models (ABC)

run_abc_robust <- function(pp, label, region, n_sim = 1200, n_r = 40, tol = 0.05) {
  r_max <- min(diff(pp$window$xrange), diff(pp$window$yrange)) / 4
  r_vals <- seq(0, r_max, length.out = n_r)
  win <- pp$window
  area_win <- area.owin(win)
  n_obs <- pp$n
  lambda <- n_obs / area_win
  d_mean <- mean(nndist(pp))
  condition_to_n <- function(sim_pp, n_target) {
    if(is.null(sim_pp) || sim_pp$n == 0) return(NULL)
    m <- sim_pp$n
    if(m == n_target) return(sim_pp)
    if(m > n_target) {
      keep <- sample.int(m, n_target)
      return(sim_pp[keep])
    }
    extra <- rpoint(n_target - m, win = win)
    superimpose(sim_pp, extra, W = win)
  }
  calc_summary_stats <- function(sim_pp) {
    if(is.null(sim_pp) || sim_pp$n < 5) return(rep(NA_real_, 5))
    K_sim <- tryCatch(Kest(sim_pp, r = r_vals, correction = "isotropic"),
                      error = function(e) NULL)
    if(is.null(K_sim)) return(rep(NA_real_, 5))
    L_sim <- sqrt(K_sim$iso / pi) - K_sim$r
    nnd_sim <- nndist(sim_pp)
    c(L_integral = sum(L_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      L_max = max(L_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      L_min = min(L_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      nn_mean = mean(nnd_sim),
      nn_cv = sd(nnd_sim) / mean(nnd_sim))
  }
  K_obs <- Kest(pp, r = r_vals, correction = "isotropic")
  L_obs <- sqrt(K_obs$iso / pi) - K_obs$r
  obs_stats <- c(L_integral = sum(L_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
                 L_max = max(L_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
                 L_min = min(L_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
                 nn_mean = mean(nndist(pp)),
                 nn_cv = sd(nndist(pp)) / mean(nndist(pp)))
  gen_csr <- function() rpoint(n_obs, win = win)
  gen_thomas <- function() {
    kappa <- lambda * runif(1, 0.05, 0.25)
    scale <- d_mean * runif(1, 0.4, 1.2)
    mu <- max(2, lambda / kappa * runif(1, 0.6, 1.4))
    out <- tryCatch(rThomas(kappa = kappa, scale = scale, mu = mu, win = win),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    condition_to_n(out, n_obs)
  }
  gen_strauss <- function() {
    out <- tryCatch(rStrauss(beta = lambda * runif(1, 1.1, 1.8),
                             gamma = runif(1, 0.05, 0.5),
                             R = d_mean * runif(1, 0.6, 1.1),
                             W = win),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    condition_to_n(out, n_obs)
  }
  models <- c("Unstructured", "Nucleated", "Dispersed")
  gens <- list(Unstructured = gen_csr, Nucleated = gen_thomas, Dispersed = gen_strauss)
  sim_per_model <- ceiling(n_sim / length(models))
  sim_blocks <- lapply(models, function(m) {
    g <- gens[[m]]
    mat <- future.apply::future_vapply(
      seq_len(sim_per_model),
      function(i) calc_summary_stats(tryCatch(g(), error = function(e) NULL)),
      FUN.VALUE = numeric(5),
      future.seed = TRUE,
      future.packages = c("spatstat.geom", "spatstat.explore", "spatstat.random")
    )
    t(mat)
  })
  sim_mat <- do.call(rbind, sim_blocks)
  sim_model <- rep(models, each = sim_per_model)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(sim_mat)
  sim_mat <- sim_mat[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  sim_model <- sim_model[ok]
  stat_sd <- apply(sim_mat, 2, sd)
  stat_sd[stat_sd == 0 | is.na(stat_sd)] <- 1
  stat_mean <- colMeans(sim_mat)
  sim_scaled <- sweep(sweep(sim_mat, 2, stat_mean, "-"), 2, stat_sd, "/")
  obs_scaled <- (obs_stats - stat_mean) / stat_sd
  dists <- sqrt(rowSums(sweep(sim_scaled, 2, obs_scaled, "-")^2))
  n_accept <- max(30, ceiling(tol * length(dists)))
  thresh <- sort(dists)[min(n_accept, length(dists))]
  accepted <- sim_model[dists <= thresh]
  counts <- sapply(models, function(m) sum(accepted == m))
  probs <- (counts + 1) / (sum(counts) + length(models))
  names(probs) <- models
  bf_nuc_vs_csr <- min(probs["Nucleated"] / probs["Unstructured"], 100)
  bf_disp_vs_csr <- min(probs["Dispersed"] / probs["Unstructured"], 100)
  tibble(
    Region = region,
    Period = label,
    N_Sites = n_obs,
    Unstructured = round(as.numeric(probs["Unstructured"]), 3),
    Nucleated = round(as.numeric(probs["Nucleated"]), 3),
    Dispersed = round(as.numeric(probs["Dispersed"]), 3),
    BF_Nucleation = round(as.numeric(bf_nuc_vs_csr), 2),
    BF_Dispersion = round(as.numeric(bf_disp_vs_csr), 2),
    Best_Model = models[which.max(probs)]
  )
}

Section 11: Multiscale Spatial Complexity (TDA) - Statistical Comparisons

run_tda_with_replicates <- function(pp, label, region, n_subsample = 80, n_boot = 300, scale_mult = 4) {
  nnd_all <- nndist(pp)
  local_scale <- median(nnd_all[nnd_all > 0])
  if(!is.finite(local_scale) || local_scale <= 0) {
    local_scale <- mean(nnd_all[nnd_all > 0])
  }
  if(!is.finite(local_scale) || local_scale <= 0) {
    win <- pp$window
    local_scale <- sqrt(diff(win$xrange)^2 + diff(win$yrange)^2) / 100
  }
  maxscale <- local_scale * scale_mult
  if(pp$n > n_subsample) {
    idx <- sample(1:pp$n, n_subsample)
    coords <- cbind(pp$x[idx], pp$y[idx])
  } else {
    coords <- cbind(pp$x, pp$y)
    n_subsample <- pp$n
  }
  calc_persistence <- function(coord_matrix, maxscale) {
    diag_result <- tryCatch(
      ripsDiag(X = coord_matrix, maxdimension = 1, maxscale = maxscale,
               library = "GUDHI", printProgress = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if(is.null(diag_result)) return(NA_real_)
    dm <- diag_result$diagram
    if(is.null(dm) || length(dm) == 0) return(0)
    if(!is.matrix(dm)) dm <- t(as.matrix(dm))
    h1 <- dm[dm[,1] == 1, , drop = FALSE]
    if(nrow(h1) == 0) return(0)
    sum(h1[,3] - h1[,2])
  }
  n_pts <- nrow(coords)
  n_boot_coords <- floor(n_pts * 0.8)
  boot_persistence <- future.apply::future_vapply(
    seq_len(n_boot),
    function(b) {
      boot_idx <- sample(1:n_pts, size = n_boot_coords, replace = FALSE)
      calc_persistence(coords[boot_idx, ], maxscale)
    },
    FUN.VALUE = numeric(1),
    future.seed = TRUE,
    future.packages = "TDA"
  )
  boot_persistence <- boot_persistence[is.finite(boot_persistence)]
  if(length(boot_persistence) == 0) boot_persistence <- 0
  spatial_complexity <- (boot_persistence / local_scale) / n_boot_coords
  spatial_complexity <- spatial_complexity[is.finite(spatial_complexity)]
  if(length(spatial_complexity) == 0) spatial_complexity <- 0
  tibble(
    Region = region,
    Period = label,
    Local_Scale_m = round(local_scale, 1),
    Spatial_Complexity = spatial_complexity
  )
}

cliffs_delta <- function(x, y) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]
  if(length(x) < 1 || length(y) < 1) return(NA_real_)
  greater <- sum(outer(x, y, ">"))
  less <- sum(outer(x, y, "<"))
  (greater - less) / (length(x) * length(y))
}

interpret_delta <- function(d) {
  if(is.na(d)) return("undetermined")
  ad <- abs(d)
  if(ad < 0.147) return("negligible")
  if(ad < 0.330) return("small")
  if(ad < 0.474) return("medium")
  "large"
}

tda_within_comparisons <- list(
  Tairona = list(c("Neguanje", "Buritaca"), c("Buritaca", "Tairona"), c("Neguanje", "Tairona")),
  Quimbaya = list(c("Early", "Middle"), c("Middle", "Late"), c("Early", "Late")),
  Muisca = list(c("Early Herrera", "Late Herrera"), c("Late Herrera", "Muisca"), c("Early Herrera", "Muisca"))
)

tda_within_tests <- bind_rows(lapply(names(tda_within_comparisons), function(r) {
  dat <- tda_all %>% filter(Region == r)
  bind_rows(lapply(tda_within_comparisons[[r]], function(comp) {
    x <- dat %>% filter(Period == comp[1]) %>% pull(Spatial_Complexity)
    y <- dat %>% filter(Period == comp[2]) %>% pull(Spatial_Complexity)
    wt <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y)), error = function(e) NULL)
    d <- cliffs_delta(x, y)
    tibble(
      Region = r,
      Comparison = paste(comp[1], "vs", comp[2]),
      Median_Diff = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE) - median(y, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      Cliffs_Delta = round(d, 3),
      Effect_Size = interpret_delta(d),
      p_value = if(is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else wt$p.value
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_Holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(c(p_value, p_adj_Holm), ~ formatC(., format = "e", digits = 2))) %>%
  mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Tairona", "Quimbaya", "Muisca"))) %>%
  arrange(Region)

tda_stage_map <- tibble(

tda_between_tests <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Early", "Middle", "Late"), function(stg) {
  dat <- tda_staged %>% filter(Stage == stg)
  bind_rows(lapply(stage_region_pairs, function(rp) {
    x <- dat %>% filter(Region == rp[1]) %>% pull(Spatial_Complexity)
    y <- dat %>% filter(Region == rp[2]) %>% pull(Spatial_Complexity)
    both_constant <- (var(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 && var(y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
    wt <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y)), error = function(e) NULL)
    d <- cliffs_delta(x, y)
    pval <- if(both_constant) NA_real_ else if(is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else wt$p.value
    tibble(
      Stage = stg,
      Comparison = paste(rp[1], "vs", rp[2]),
      Cliffs_Delta = round(d, 3),
      Effect_Size = interpret_delta(d),
      Note = if(both_constant) "both constant" else "tested",
      p_value = pval
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  group_by(Stage) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_Holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(c(p_value, p_adj_Holm), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "NA", formatC(., format = "e", digits = 2)))) %>%
  mutate(Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c("Early", "Middle", "Late"))) %>%
  arrange(Stage)

density_low <- 5
density_mid <- 7.5
density_high <- 10

  "Neguanje", "Buritaca", "Tairona",
  "Early", "Middle", "Late",
  "Early Herrera", "Late Herrera", "Muisca"
)

# Corrected bootstrap function for this section only.
# This avoids the previous problem where CI80, CI95, and CI99 were returned in the wrong order.
boot_mean_ci_demo <- function(values, n_boot = 10000) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  n <- length(values)

  if(n < 2) {
    m <- if(n == 1) values[1] else NA_real_
    return(tibble(
      Mean = m,
      L80 = m, U80 = m,
      L95 = m, U95 = m,
      L99 = m, U99 = m,
      N = n
    ))
  }

  boot_means <- future.apply::future_vapply(
    seq_len(n_boot),
    function(b) mean(sample(values, n, replace = TRUE)),
    FUN.VALUE = numeric(1),
    future.seed = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    Mean = mean(values),
    L80 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(boot_means, 0.10,  na.rm = TRUE)),
    U80 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(boot_means, 0.90,  na.rm = TRUE)),
    L95 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(boot_means, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    U95 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(boot_means, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    L99 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(boot_means, 0.005, na.rm = TRUE)),
    U99 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(boot_means, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)),
    N = n
  )
}

    x <- dat %>%
      filter(Period == comp[1]) %>%
      pull(Pop_Mid)

    y <- dat %>%
      filter(Period == comp[2]) %>%
      pull(Pop_Mid)

    wt <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    d <- cliffs_delta(x, y)

    tibble(
      Region = r,
      Comparison = paste(comp[1], "vs", comp[2]),
      Median_Diff = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE) - median(y, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Cliffs_Delta = round(d, 3),
      Effect_Size = interpret_delta(d),
      p_value = if(is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else wt$p.value
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_Holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(p_value, p_adj_Holm),
      ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "NA", formatC(., format = "e", digits = 2))

Section 13: Network Construction Sensitivity Analysis

graph_metrics <- function(g) {
  deg <- degree(g)
  btw <- betweenness(g, normalized = TRUE)
  c(
    avg_degree = mean(deg),
    transitivity = transitivity(g, type = "global"),
    degree_centralization = centr_degree(g)$centralization,
    mean_betweenness = mean(btw),
    max_betweenness = max(btw),
    sd_betweenness = sd(btw)
  )
}

build_knn_graph <- function(coords, k) {
  n <- nrow(coords)
  D <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  adj <- matrix(FALSE, n, n)
  for(i in 1:n) {
    k_eff <- min(k, n - 1)
    nb <- order(D[i, ])[2:(k_eff + 1)]
    adj[i, nb] <- TRUE
  }
  adj <- adj | t(adj)
  graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj, mode = "undirected")
}

build_gabriel_graph <- function(coords) {
  gg <- cccd::gg(x = coords)
  as.undirected(gg, mode = "collapse")
}

build_threshold_graph <- function(coords, threshold) {
  D <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  adj <- D <= threshold & D > 0
  graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj, mode = "undirected")
}

all_nnd <- unlist(c(
  lapply(ppp_tairona, nndist),
  lapply(ppp_quimbaya, nndist),
  lapply(ppp_muisca, nndist)
))
global_threshold <- as.numeric(quantile(all_nnd, 0.90))

compute_construction_comparison <- function(ppp_list, region) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(ppp_list), function(p) {
    pp <- ppp_list[[p]]
    coords <- cbind(pp$x, pp$y)
    g_knn <- build_knn_graph(coords, 6)
    g_gab <- build_gabriel_graph(coords)
    g_thr <- build_threshold_graph(coords, global_threshold)
    m_knn <- graph_metrics(g_knn)
    m_gab <- graph_metrics(g_gab)
    m_thr <- graph_metrics(g_thr)
    bind_rows(
      tibble(Region = region, Period = p, Construction = "k-NN (k=6)",
             Avg_Degree = round(m_knn["avg_degree"], 3),
             Transitivity = round(m_knn["transitivity"], 3),
             Degree_Centralization = round(m_knn["degree_centralization"], 4),
             Mean_Betweenness = round(m_knn["mean_betweenness"], 4),
             Max_Betweenness = round(m_knn["max_betweenness"], 4),
             SD_Betweenness = round(m_knn["sd_betweenness"], 4)),
      tibble(Region = region, Period = p, Construction = "Gabriel graph",
             Avg_Degree = round(m_gab["avg_degree"], 3),
             Transitivity = round(m_gab["transitivity"], 3),
             Degree_Centralization = round(m_gab["degree_centralization"], 4),
             Mean_Betweenness = round(m_gab["mean_betweenness"], 4),
             Max_Betweenness = round(m_gab["max_betweenness"], 4),
             SD_Betweenness = round(m_gab["sd_betweenness"], 4)),
      tibble(Region = region, Period = p,
             Construction = paste0("Distance threshold (", round(global_threshold), " m)"),
             Avg_Degree = round(m_thr["avg_degree"], 3),
             Transitivity = round(m_thr["transitivity"], 3),
             Degree_Centralization = round(m_thr["degree_centralization"], 4),
             Mean_Betweenness = round(m_thr["mean_betweenness"], 4),
             Max_Betweenness = round(m_thr["max_betweenness"], 4),
             SD_Betweenness = round(m_thr["sd_betweenness"], 4))
    )
  }))
}

) %>%

compute_k_sweep <- function(ppp_list, region, k_values = c(4, 6, 8, 10)) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(ppp_list), function(p) {
    pp <- ppp_list[[p]]
    coords <- cbind(pp$x, pp$y)
    bind_rows(lapply(k_values, function(k) {
      g <- build_knn_graph(coords, k)
      m <- graph_metrics(g)
      tibble(Region = region, Period = p, k = k,
             Degree_Centralization = round(m["degree_centralization"], 4),
             Mean_Betweenness = round(m["mean_betweenness"], 4),
             Max_Betweenness = round(m["max_betweenness"], 4),
             SD_Betweenness = round(m["sd_betweenness"], 4))
    }))
  }))
}

  compute_k_sweep(ppp_muisca, "Muisca")
) %>%
  mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Tairona", "Quimbaya", "Muisca")),
         Period = factor(Period, levels = period_order)) %>%
  arrange(Region, Period, k)

Section 15: Machine Learning Classification of Regional Signatures

extract_site_features <- function(poly_list, ppp_list, region_name) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(poly_list), function(p) {
    pts <- ppp_list[[p]]
    n_sites <- pts$n
    nnd_vals <- nndist(pts)
    safe_bw <- tryCatch({
      b <- suppressWarnings(bw.ppl(pts))
      if(!is.finite(as.numeric(b)) || as.numeric(b) <= 0) stop("non-finite bw")
      as.numeric(b)
    }, error = function(e) {
      fb <- as.numeric(mean(nndist(pts))) * 1.5
      if(!is.finite(fb) || fb <= 0) {
        win <- pts$window
        fb <- sqrt(diff(win$xrange)^2 + diff(win$yrange)^2) / 50
      }
      fb
    })
    dens_at_pts <- density(pts, sigma = safe_bw, edge = TRUE, at = "points")
    dens_vals <- as.numeric(dens_at_pts)
    if(any(!is.finite(dens_vals))) {
      med_d <- median(dens_vals[is.finite(dens_vals)])
      dens_vals[!is.finite(dens_vals)] <- med_d
    }
    k <- 5
    D <- as.matrix(dist(cbind(pts$x, pts$y)))
    regularity_vals <- sapply(1:nrow(D), function(i) {
      knn_dists <- sort(D[i, ])[2:(k+1)]
      cv <- sd(knn_dists) / mean(knn_dists)
      return(1 / (cv + 0.1))
    })
    k_net <- 6
    coords <- cbind(pts$x, pts$y)
    adj_knn <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = n_sites, ncol = n_sites)
    for(i in 1:n_sites) {
      neighbors <- order(D[i, ])[2:(k_net+1)]
      adj_knn[i, neighbors] <- TRUE
    }
    adj_knn <- adj_knn | t(adj_knn)
    g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_knn, mode = "undirected")
    betweenness_vals <- betweenness(g, normalized = TRUE)
    clustering_vals <- transitivity(g, type = "local")
    clustering_vals[is.nan(clustering_vals)] <- 0
    tibble(
      Region = factor(region_name),
      Period = p,
      NND = nnd_vals,
      Local_Density = dens_vals,
      Spacing_Regularity = regularity_vals,
      Betweenness = betweenness_vals,
      Local_Clustering = clustering_vals
    )
  }))
}

data_ml_tai <- extract_site_features(sites_tairona, ppp_tairona, "Tairona")
data_ml_qui <- extract_site_features(sites_quimbaya, ppp_quimbaya, "Quimbaya")
data_ml_mui <- extract_site_features(sites_muisca, ppp_muisca, "Muisca")
data_all <- bind_rows(data_ml_tai, data_ml_qui, data_ml_mui)

data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Tairona", "Quimbaya", "Muisca")),
         Region_Period = paste(Region, Period, sep = " - "))

ml_feature_cols <- c("NND", "Local_Density", "Spacing_Regularity", "Betweenness", "Local_Clustering")

data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(ml_feature_cols), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.), ., NA_real_)))

n_before <- nrow(data_all)
data_all <- data_all %>% filter(if_all(all_of(ml_feature_cols), ~ !is.na(.)))
n_after <- nrow(data_all)

na_report <- tibble(
  Stage = c("Rows before NA filter", "Rows after NA filter", "Rows removed"),
  Count = c(n_before, n_after, n_before - n_after)
)

set.seed(42)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(data_all$Region, p = .75, list = FALSE, times = 1)
dataTrain <- data_all[trainIndex,]
dataTest  <- data_all[-trainIndex,]

rf_total_trees <- 1000
rf_predictors <- c("NND", "Local_Density", "Spacing_Regularity", "Betweenness", "Local_Clustering")
rf_x <- dataTrain[, rf_predictors]
rf_y <- dataTrain$Region

set.seed(42)
rf_model <- randomForest(x = rf_x, y = rf_y, ntree = rf_total_trees, importance = TRUE)

pred <- predict(rf_model, dataTest[, rf_predictors])
cm <- confusionMatrix(pred, dataTest$Region)

imp_df <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
imp_df$Variable <- rownames(imp_df)
imp_df <- imp_df %>%
  mutate(
    Variable_Label = case_when(
      Variable == "NND" ~ "Inter-Site Spacing",
      Variable == "Local_Density" ~ "Nucleation Intensity",
      Variable == "Spacing_Regularity" ~ "Spacing Regularity",
      Variable == "Betweenness" ~ "Network Betweenness (bridging)",
      Variable == "Local_Clustering" ~ "Local Cohesion"
    ),
    Importance_Scaled = MeanDecreaseGini / max(MeanDecreaseGini) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance_Scaled))

acc_text <- paste0("Accuracy: ", round(cm$overall['Accuracy'] * 100, 1), "%")
kappa_text <- paste0("Kappa = ", round(cm$overall['Kappa'], 2))

pca_vars <- c("NND", "Local_Density", "Spacing_Regularity", "Betweenness", "Local_Clustering")
data_scaled <- data_all %>% mutate(across(all_of(pca_vars), scale))
pca_result <- prcomp(data_scaled[, pca_vars], center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
pca_scores$Region <- data_all$Region
pca_scores$Period <- data_all$Period
pca_scores$Region_Period <- data_all$Region_Period

centroids <- pca_scores %>%
  group_by(Region, Period, Region_Period) %>%
  summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), N = n(), .groups = "drop")

var_explained <- round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation[, 1:2])
loadings$Variable <- imp_df$Variable_Label[match(rownames(loadings), imp_df$Variable)]
arrow_scale <- 3

p8a_pca <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Region), alpha = 0.15, size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = centroids, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = Region),
             shape = 21, size = 9, color = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = centroids, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = N),
            size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * arrow_scale, yend = PC2 * arrow_scale),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = loadings,
            aes(x = PC1 * arrow_scale * 1.15, y = PC2 * arrow_scale * 1.15, label = Variable),
            size = 2.6, color = "gray30", fontface = "italic") +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_palette) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 7: Machine Learning Classification of Regional Spatial Signatures",
    subtitle = paste0("PCA of site-level spatial signatures (centroids by period, N = site count) | ", acc_text, " | ", kappa_text),
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  coord_fixed()

imp_inset <- ggplot(imp_df, aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, Importance_Scaled), y = Importance_Scaled)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#444444", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Importance_Scaled, 0), "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.4) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, 115)) +

        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray70"))
